member.name: T:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter

member.summary: Converts a CIM instance or object to a hashtable with cached property reflection.

member.summary: Converts an array of complex objects to an array of hashtables.

member.returns: Array of hashtables representing the complex objects

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter.ConvertArray(System.Array)
member.summary: Converts an array, handling nested CIM instances and complex objects.
member.returns: A new array with the converted values.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter.IsCimLikeObject(System.Object)
member.summary: Determines if an object is a CIM-like complex object (not a primitive or common .NET type).
member.returns: True if the object is CIM-like, false otherwise.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter.GetValueFromObject(System.Object)
member.summary: Gets a value from an object, handling various types.
member.param: The object to get the value from.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter.GetValueFromGraphObject(System.Object)
member.summary: Creates a hashtable representation of the public and selected non-public properties of the specified complex object.
member.remarks: Properties named "EntityItem" are excluded from the result. Non-public properties containing "AdditionalProperties" in their name are also included. The method uses a cache to improve performance when processing objects of the same type.
member.param: The object whose properties are to be extracted and represented in the resulting hashtable. Cannot be null.
member.returns: A hashtable containing the names and values of the object's properties. Property names are used as keys, and their corresponding values are recursively processed. The hashtable is case-insensitive with respect to keys.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ComplexObjectConverter.ClearCache
member.summary: Clears the property reflection cache (primarily for testing purposes).

member.name: T:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ObjectNormalizer
member.summary: Recursively converts any object (CimInstance, PSObject, IDictionary, Graph SDK types, arrays of any of these) into a uniform Hashtable tree with case-insensitive key lookup. After normalization every node is either a Hashtable, a primitive/string, or an object[] of those. This eliminates all CimInstance/PSObject type-specific handling from the comparison pipeline.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ObjectNormalizer.Normalize(System.Object)
member.summary: Normalizes an arbitrary object into the primitives, Array or Hashtable tree. - null stays null - Primitives, strings, DateTime, Guid stay as-is - Arrays become object[] where each element is normalized - CimInstance / PSObject / IDictionary / Graph SDK objects become Hashtable (case-insensitive) with recursively normalized values

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ObjectNormalizer.IsLeafType(System.Object)
member.summary: Returns true if the object is a leaf type that should not be decomposed further.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ObjectNormalizer.NormalizeArray(System.Array)
member.summary: Normalizes an array. Returns object[] with each element normalized.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.ObjectNormalizer.NormalizeEnumerable(System.Collections.IEnumerable)
member.summary: Normalizes an IEnumerable (non-array, non-string, non-dictionary) by materializing to a list and converting to object[].

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Converter.SimpleObjectConverter.ToDscString(System.String,System.Object,System.String)
member.summary: Converts a simple object type to its string representation in DSC format.
member.returns: A formatted string representation of the key-value pair
